title: Durable PostgreSQL storage for offline Solana address-mining reports
objective: Add an offline-only PostgreSQL report store for completed daily/weekly Solana address-mining runs. Preserve deterministic fixture behavior, capture run metrics and evidence summaries, and fail closed/degrade visibly when configured persistence fails. Do not connect to or deploy PostgreSQL, Redis, schedulers, or live providers.
forbidden_actions: Do not call live Helius, RPC, market-provider, database, Redis, scheduler, or HTTP APIs.
Do not connect to or deploy PostgreSQL or Redis.
Do not add dependencies or modify existing migrations.
Do not activate a scheduled trigger, unpark SOL-E2E-001, or activate BSC.
Do not persist raw provider payloads, credentials, or secrets.
